node: Workforce credential content, licensure prep, and continuing education
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the direct public-company universe for regulated workforce credential content, licensure prep, and continuing education. The strongest underfollowed direct exposure found in this pass is HealthStream, where healthcare continuing education, compliance training, credentialing, and workforce development are core products. Graham Holdings/Kaplan is a diversified but meaningful hidden exposure through exam prep, professional licensure, certification, and continuing education. American Public Education and Adtalem are more direct regulated-education asset owners and customers/content operators in nursing and healthcare credential pathways; they are useful anchors for accreditation, NCLEX, clinical workforce, and professional-degree demand, though not all revenue is pure continuing education content. Layer 1B expanded the workforce credential content node into a two-lane public universe. The reference lane includes Pearson as the scaled testing/certification infrastructure anchor and Graham Holdings/Kaplan as a diversified owner of licensure prep and professional education assets. The underfollowed lane is led by HealthStream, a healthcare-specific workforce learning, credentialing, and compliance platform, plus Skillsoft as a micro-cap speculative exception in enterprise compliance and professional certification training. The strongest chokepoint signals are healthcare credentialing workflows, accredited/regulated continuing education, employer-distributed compliance training, and exam-prep reputation. No buy/sell recommendation is provided. Layer 1B expanded the public
